# Ash Stu

> Official site of Ash Stu (Ashton Stubblefield), outsider singer-songwriter from Guthrie, Oklahoma. Every song's full lyrics are published here by the artist as plain HTML, one page per song.

## Lyrics

- [All lyrics](https://ashstu.art/lyrics/): every song, grouped by release
